properties.description: Pacific Drive is a first-person driving survival game set in the Pacific Northwest where your car is your only companion as you explore the surreal Olympic Exclusion Zone, scavenge, upgrade your vehicle, and survive strange environmental hazards while uncovering hidden mysteries.
properties.short_description: Alone in a mysterious exclusion zone, you drive a customizable car to survive, scavenge resources, and uncover the zone's surreal secrets.

short_descriptions.value: Ein Fahrer navigiert durch eine mysteriöse Sperrzone, entdeckt Anomalien und eine dunkle Vergangenheit und versucht mit unerwarteten Verbündeten zu entkommen.
Un conductor atraviesa una zona de exclusión misteriosa, descubriendo anomalías y un oscuro pasado mientras busca escapar con la ayuda de aliados inesperados.
Un conducteur traverse une zone d'exclusion mystérieuse, découvrant des anomalies et un passé sombre tout en cherchant à s'échapper avec l'aide d'alliés inattendus.
A driver navigates a mysterious exclusion zone, uncovering anomalies and a dark past while seeking to escape with the help of unexpected allies.

results.name: Clad in Iron: War of The Pacific 1879

properties.description: Manage your fleet and army, hunt the enemy's fleet, hide your weak squadrons in protected ports until reinforcements arrive, blockade enemy trade routes, amphibious assaults and harbour sieges, struggle for dominance over the seas in turned-based strategy mode - all of these actions are possible in CLAD in IRON: War of the Pacific 1879.\n\nThe real time tactical battle (simulation) mode allows you to set up battles and squadron groups with their formations and management using realistic ship models and characteristics as well as advanced ballistics and weapon models. Choose your ships, increase the experience of your crews and send your squadron into the high seas. Command a battle formation and experience the power of iron and steam in a turned-based maritime strategy mode while fighting battles with a tactical real time naval simulation game.
properties.short_description: Command your fleet in strategic naval battles and manage resources to dominate the seas during a historical conflict.

short_descriptions.value: Führe deine Flotte in strategischen Seeschlachten und verwalte Ressourcen, um während eines historischen Konflikts die Meere zu beherrschen.
Comanda tu flota en batallas navales estratégicas y gestiona recursos para dominar los mares durante un conflicto histórico.
Commandez votre flotte dans des batailles navales stratégiques et gérez les ressources pour dominer les mers lors d'un conflit historique.
Command your fleet in strategic naval battles and manage resources to dominate the seas during a historical conflict.

properties.description: Ace Pilot Pacific is my 3rd game and I have been working on it for around a year and a half. The action takes place during World War 2 in the Pacific.\n\nYou will fly one of the six different aircraft available against the Japanese. You will be dog fighting against Zeros, Ki43, Ki49, G4M, G4M2, Hk8K2, Nakajima Kikka, J8M Shusui, and Shinden.
properties.short_description: Players engage in aerial dogfights during World War 2 in the Pacific, piloting various aircraft against Japanese forces.

short_descriptions.value: Spieler kämpfen in Luftkämpfen während des Zweiten Weltkriegs im Pazifik und steuern verschiedene Flugzeuge gegen japanische Streitkräfte.
Los jugadores participan en combates aéreos durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial en el Pacífico, pilotando diversas aeronaves contra las fuerzas japonesas.
Les joueurs participent à des combats aériens pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale dans le Pacifique, pilotant divers avions contre les forces japonaises.
Players engage in aerial dogfights during World War 2 in the Pacific, piloting various aircraft against Japanese forces.

properties.description: In This Dreamlike Game You play mostly as Orangie the Orangutan and Orangie wishes to collect all the tasty Bananas in this slightly difficult Open World driving Dream \"Game\".
properties.short_description: An orangutan navigates a dreamlike open world to collect bananas while overcoming various challenges.

short_descriptions.value: Ein Orang-Utan erkundet eine traumhafte offene Welt, sammelt Bananen und meistert verschiedene Herausforderungen.
Un orangután navega un mundo abierto onírico para recoger plátanos mientras supera varios desafíos.
Un orang-outan explore un monde ouvert onirique pour collecter des bananes tout en surmontant divers défis.
An orangutan navigates a dreamlike open world to collect bananas while overcoming various challenges.

properties.description:
In the world of "Drive Up," you're not just driving; you're embarking on a thrilling journey. Your adventure begins on a mysterious island with only one road leading upward. Your mission is crystal clear: reach the finish line without any tumbles because there are no checkpoints!

The road you navigate is treacherous, filled with unexpected twists, steep inclines, and narrow paths that seem to defy gravity. As you rev your engines and embark on this incredible journey, you'll come to realize that every inch of progress matters.

"Drive Up" is a test of your driving skills, your nerve, and your ability to adapt to an ever-changing landscape. One wrong move could send you tumbling into the abyss below, and there's no safety net to catch you. But remember, in the world of "Drive Up," mistakes are your greatest teachers, and each setback is a chance to learn and grow.
properties.short_description: Navigate a treacherous road on a mysterious island, testing your driving skills without checkpoints or safety nets.

short_descriptions.value: Navigiere eine gefährliche Straße auf einer mysteriösen Insel und teste deine Fahrkünste ohne Checkpoints oder Sicherheitsnetze.
Conduce por una carretera peligrosa en una isla misteriosa, poniendo a prueba tus habilidades sin puntos de control ni redes de seguridad.
Parcourez une route périlleuse sur une île mystérieuse, testant vos compétences de conduite sans points de contrôle ni filet de sécurité.
Navigate a treacherous road on a mysterious island, testing your driving skills without checkpoints or safety nets.
